title: Within The Villainess
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Emi is reborn in a romance video game as Remilia, its villainess, and despite all her efforts the game's lying heroine gets her unjustly condemned. The original Remilia, who had been watching from inside the same body, then awakens and takes over to clear Emi's name. What follows is a calculated, ruthless revenge story against the heroine and those who wronged them (Kana/Abrams publisher page; Ichijinsha blurb; MU Multiple Persons in the Same Body).
life_message: Loyalty to someone who loved you can justify any lengths of retribution against those who wronged her.
